title: Steelers could try to not pay Aaron Rodgers the balance of his $22 million salary

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers could try to not pay Aaron Rodgers the balance of his $22 million salary
sources.description: If/when the Steelers release quarterback Aaron Rodgers, they'll have to decide whether to willingly pay the balance of his $22 million base salary, or whether to fight.
